# SpacesMate

> SpacesMate is a Thai property rental platform and full-service building
> management company, operated by Space Works Co., Ltd. in Bangkok. Owners list
> rentable space on a monthly subscription from THB 299 per listing. SpacesMate
> also manages apartment buildings and condominium units end to end for owners
> on a performance-based fee.

Primary market: Bangkok, Thailand. Property types covered: apartments,
condominiums, houses, offices and co-working space.

Languages: Thai is served at the root (https://spacesmate.com/...). English is
served under /en/ (https://spacesmate.com/en/...). Pages that exist in both
declare each other with rel="alternate" hreflang tags.

## How rent is quoted

Rent is quoted in Thai baht (THB) and is per month unless a listing is marked
as a daily rental. Listing pages state the period explicitly in their
structured data rather than leaving a bare figure to be interpreted.

## Key pages

- [Search listings](https://spacesmate.com/search): every active rental listing, with filters
- [Pricing](https://spacesmate.com/pricing): listing subscription tiers
- [Services](https://spacesmate.com/services): full property management for building owners
- [FAQ](https://spacesmate.com/faq): listing, fees, and management questions answered
- [Blog](https://spacesmate.com/blog): Bangkok rental market guidance
- [About](https://spacesmate.com/about)
- [Contact](https://spacesmate.com/contact)

## Area guides

Neighbourhood rental guides organised by BTS and MRT station and by district,
each with live inventory for that area.

- Thai: https://spacesmate.com/area/<slug>
- English: https://spacesmate.com/en/area/<slug>

## Structured data

Listing pages carry schema.org RealEstateListing with an Accommodation
mainEntity: geo coordinates, bedroom and bathroom counts, floor area in square
metres (unitCode MTK), amenities, and an Offer whose UnitPriceSpecification
gives the rent period as unitCode MON for monthly or DAY for daily.

Area pages carry ItemList, BreadcrumbList and FAQPage. The organisation is
described once site-wide as a RealEstateAgent entity.
